source: tools/lich_hands.py (build) from the ROM and the runs named in measured_runs; tick = 5 frames = 83.2 ms (12.02 Hz); seconds = frames / 60.0988; docs/dark-lich-hands.md

state_meaning_and_entry.1E: hands idle (low); chooser, bit 15 clear, direction 0/2, rand(0..1)=0
state_meaning_and_entry.1F: hands move +y; chooser, bit 15 clear, direction 1
state_meaning_and_entry.20: hands rise, sets bit 15; chooser, bit 15 clear, direction 0/2, rand(0..1)=1
state_meaning_and_entry.21: raised idle; chooser, bit 15 set, direction 0/2, rand(0..1)=0
state_meaning_and_entry.22: raised, move +y; chooser, bit 15 set, direction 1
state_meaning_and_entry.23: hands lower, clears bit 15; chooser, bit 15 set, direction 0/2, rand(0..1)=1
state_meaning_and_entry.24: slam (the hands action); action routine, bit 15 clear, AD >= threshold
state_meaning_and_entry.25: hurt (hands); hit flag consumed in mode 1 with bit 0 of 7E set
state_meaning_and_entry.26: hands move -y; chooser, bit 15 clear, direction 3
state_meaning_and_entry.27: raised, move -y; chooser, bit 15 set, direction 3
state_meaning_and_entry.07: hurt (body); hit flag consumed in mode 1 with bit 0 of 7E clear

selection_tables.note: values are state sequence addresses in bank C2: E864=1E E866=1F E868=20 E86A=21 E86C=22 E86E=23 E870=26 E872=27 E894=24 E860=1B-1C-1D E84C=25 E84A=07; direction code 0 right, 1 down, 2 left, 3 up
